Reasoning: This stage retracts the open panda_fingertip from the released top_drawer_handle_frame to a non-contact offset 0.10 m along the handle frame -y direction. The position goal is encoded as a reach_point to the top_drawer_handle_frame-relative offset with 0.01 m tolerance, with manipulator_low_effort included to represent maintaining free-space/no-contact interaction during retract. The gripper is commanded/required open with gripper_opened feedback metadata. The current start-of-stage panda_fingertip orientation is preserved using freeze_orientation, which keeps the tool +z and +y directions fixed relative to their start directions within the controller orientation threshold. Direct monitoring requirements are implicit in the feedback conditions; gripper joint-state verification is represented by open_gripper/gripper_opened. There is no dedicated API term for gripper-specific effort/no bilateral grasp-contact feedback, so that part is only partially represented by the open gripper state and low-effort free-space condition.
